canonical_disappearing_entity: the lineage component containing the LATEST code->legal-name binding within the event's own domain
declared_exposure: D6.8 event outcomes and the corpus name-FORM structure were both inspected before this freeze; no rule was selected by which event it admits

extraction_pattern.code_key: \s*[（(]?\s*(?:上櫃|上市|興櫃)?(?:股票代號|證券代號|公司代號|代號)[：:\s]*[（(]?\s*
extraction_pattern.gap_between_name_and_key: (?:[普通特別股票之有價證券上櫃櫃檯國內外]{0,12})

identity_source_track_b: code-first LEGAL-NAME binding printed by TPEx in its own preserved announcement bodies
same_entity_requires: first-party TPEx rename evidence 「A更名為B」 or 「原名A」; never fuzzy similarity, guessed abbreviation, or free substring matching between two different validated names
suffix_collapse_scope: within a single security code only
